chain.label: Narrow steep-walled Descent Canyon tour route
chain.trigger: Descent Canyon is a side (tributary) canyon ... pilots descend from about 4,800 feet to about 1,200 feet msl (about 3,600 feet) in 3 to 3.5 minutes

chain.label: Sundance failed to enforce discipline or route-check the pilot despite known reckless flying
chain.trigger: a written reprimand given to the pilot 2 years before the accident, which called for a 1-week suspension without pay, was never enforced

chain.label: FAA conducted no in-flight surveillance of Descent Canyon tour operations
chain.trigger: neither the POI nor the APOI knew the frequency of the Sundance tours into Descent Canyon, and neither conducted any in-flight surveillance of the tour operations there

chain.label: Pilot's habitual violation of company, TOPS and Federal maneuvering limits
chain.trigger: the accident pilot regularly exceeded the maximum of 30º bank and 10º pitch—sometimes by extreme margins and into the realm of aerobatic flight—during flights with passengers on board

caused_by.evidence: The company's failure to enforce the reprimand might have conveyed to the pilot and other Sundance pilots that the completion of tours was more important than safety policies and procedures
If the FAA had provided such surveillance, it may have observed the reckless flying that was observed by passengers and may have taken action to ensure Sundance's compliance

chain.label: Pilot flew accident descent as an aggressive high-speed, steep-bank thrill profile
chain.trigger: the accident flight was consistent with the accident pilot's typical flight profile through Descent Canyon

caused_by.evidence: represented a deliberate and repetitive disregard of safe flying margins while transporting passengers through Descent Canyon

chain.label: Helicopter operated at high airspeed and low altitude within the canyon
chain.trigger: The airspeed indicator shows an airspeed between 145 and 150 knots ... The helicopter appears to be at low altitude and close to the right canyon wall

caused_by.evidence: he flew the descent “doing 120 to 140 knots” ... estimated that the helicopter's altitude was about 100 to 150 feet agl

chain.label: Insufficient clearance maintained from near-vertical canyon wall
chain.trigger: “flew very close to the canyon wall. Banked off one wall and then turned the other way, almost upside down”

caused_by.evidence: the initial impact point was a gouge in a near-vertical canyon wall about 1.2 nm from the canyon rim
its horizontal clearance from the right wall of the canyon was about 75 to 100 feet

chain.label: Main rotor blade struck the canyon wall, damaging the rotor system
chain.trigger: The helicopter's main rotor blade struck a near-vertical canyon wall in flight.

caused_by.evidence: consistent with the accident helicopter flying at a high airspeed in a near-level flightpath when its main rotor blade first struck the canyon wall

chain.label: Helicopter rendered uncontrollable after rotor damage
chain.trigger: The resulting damage to the main rotor system likely rendered the helicopter uncontrollable

caused_by.evidence: The resulting damage to the main rotor system likely rendered the helicopter uncontrollable

chain.label: Impact with canyon wall ledge and postcrash fire
chain.trigger: the helicopter subsequently impacted a canyon wall ledge

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter was destroyed by impact forces and postcrash fire

chain.label: Pilot and six passengers fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot and all six passengers on board were killed

caused_by.evidence: The accident was not survivable because of high impact forces and fire.
